exposure: number of expressing sessions per day (e.g., >=8 times, <6 times, 6-7 times)
outcome: achievement of UK target of 750g breastmilk
cohort: The study included 132 mothers of very premature infants born between 23+0 and 31+6 weeks' gestation.
finding: Expressing frequency was positively associated with 24-hour milk yield, with expressing ≥8 times per day generally linked to higher yield, and prior breastmilk feeding experience also boosting milk yield.
